versions.name: Final product
versions.summary: The whole planned product in plain words: 17 screens, an honest status tag on every screen and item (working today / partly / built, switched off / planned), assistant panel, roles, and a What's real today page. This is the target for the real product.

versions.name: Plain
versions.summary: The core six-step churn story in plain data-science words: data, goal and test design, experiments, model, predictions, monitoring. No internal codes or AI-governance jargon.

versions.name: Based on the plans
versions.summary: Every screen mapped to its route, phase and prompt from docs/mvp: the state graph as the plan names it, the hybrid AI decision model at every decision point, AI on/off and a built-today view, roles per STUDIO_DESIGN, and a Plan page.

versions.name: Flow
versions.summary: The state graph becomes the navigation: a flow bar on every project screen, cleaner surfaces, plainer tags and a lighter guide. All of version 2's detail kept.

versions.name: Guided
versions.summary: Version 2's full detail, reorganized: a workflow sidebar, a guide on every screen, explained terms and a clear next step.

versions.name: Clean
versions.summary: The product look: 10 screens, one job each, details behind tabs, plain words.

versions.name: Detailed, tabbed
versions.summary: Every detail kept. 16 screens, larger type, dense cards split into section tabs, review notes on each page.

versions.name: Detailed
versions.summary: The first full walkthrough. 16 screens showing every field, id and review note.
